items.question: Is there a minimum commitment?
items.answer: No. Monthly retainers and one-time projects available.

items.question: Do you work outside the GCC?
items.answer: Our focus is GCC-based businesses. Reach out to discuss.

items.question: What happens after I get in touch?
items.answer: We set up a short intro call to understand your goals and scope the work.

items.question: Is the first call free?
items.answer: Yes. The discovery call is complimentary, with no obligation.

items.question: How soon can we start?
items.answer: Typically within a week of agreeing on scope and terms.
